ระบบภูมิคุ้มกันผิวบกพร่อง: เม็ดเลือดขาวท: Impaired skin immunity: White blood cells work less effectively, leaving the skin weak and without a protective barrier, so fungi, bacteria and allergens can easily attack the skin layers.
อักเสบรุนแรงและเซลล์ผิวโตผิดปกติ: ในรายท: Severe inflammation and abnormal skin cell growth: In cases of psoriasis, the skin is chronically inflamed and sheds cells too quickly, becoming thick, scaly and constantly irritated.
เชื้อราฝังลึกในชั้นใต้เล็บ: เชื้อราเข้าไ: Fungus deep under the nails: Fungi eat away at the keratin under the nails, turning the nail yellow-black, making it brittle and easily broken, and causing an unpleasant odour.
แสบคันทรมาน ยิ่งเกายิ่งลาม: อาการแสบร้อน: Agonising burning and itching that spreads the more you scratch: Burning, prickly itching and repeated secondary bacterial infections turn into blistering sores that spread across the body.
สูญเสียความมั่นใจ ไม่กล้าเข้าสังคม: ไม่อ: Loss of confidence and avoiding social situations: Not wanting to wear short sleeves or shorts, not wanting to take off your shoes and let anyone see your nails, having to hide until it affects your personality and confidence.
เครียดจนโรคกำเริบหนักกว่าเดิม: โรคผิวหนั: Stress that makes the condition flare up worse than before: Skin diseases and psoriasis flare up the more stressed you are, becoming a vicious cycle that never fully clears no matter how much you treat it.
สยบการลุกลามของเชื้อรา: ออกฤทธิ์ยับยั้งก: Halts the spread of fungi: Acts to inhibit the growth of fungi and bacteria in the skin and nails, keeping them from spreading any further than before.
ฟื้นฟูเซลล์ผิวหนังอย่างล้ำลึก: ตรงเข้าฟื: Deeply restores skin cells: Goes straight to restoring damaged skin cells, reducing dry, peeling, scaly and flaky skin so it becomes smooth again and looks healthy.
กู้คืนโครงสร้างเล็บ ลดกลิ่นเหม็นอับ: ซ่อ: Restores nail structure, reduces musty odour: Repairs and restores the structure of fingernails and toenails deformed or discoloured by fungi, and eliminates unpleasant odours.
เสริมภูมิคุ้มกันผิว ป้องกันการติดเชื้อซ้: Strengthens skin immunity, prevents reinfection: Stimulates white blood cell activity and nourishes the immune system from within, preventing skin diseases from flaring up again.
